column1: # BRANCH PROTECT LIST — hand-maintained. The ONLY hand-entered input to branch deletion.
# scripts/branch-cleanup.cjs derives everything else from git and the GitHub API: what is in
# main, what a pull ref holds, what the archive branch covers, what heads an open PR. This file
# answers the one question no machine in CI can:
#     IS SOMEONE STANDING ON THIS BRANCH RIGHT NOW?
# WHY IT CANNOT BE DERIVED. A GitHub Actions runner cannot read the Claude session API. A branch
# can be `in-main` — the safest bucket there is, its commits inside main AND inside a permanent
# pull ref — and still be the outcome branch of a running session. Deleting it loses no commit
# and still breaks that session's push. `feat/landing-coach-first` is exactly that: PR #595
# HOW TO REFRESH, and it MUST be refreshed before any deletion run — the set changes by the hour:
#   NOT external_metadata.current_branches, which holds the REPO NAME. 46 sessions report
#   "barakatammre84/Homiquity" there and 14 report an empty string; reading the wrong field
#   returns a plausible list of nothing.
# Sessions whose status is ARCHIVED are deliberately NOT listed — an archived session is not
# coming back to push. Five such branches were seen and left deletable.
